card.name: Injection Fairy Lily
card.effect: Once per battle, during damage calculation, if this card battles (Quick Effect): You can pay 2000 LP; this card gains 3000 ATK during that damage calculation only.

behavior: Only plans during a real Damage Calculation window when the face-up source is the attacker or defender in the supplied battle.
The controller team, not the physical owner seat, pays 2000 LP from the team's shared LP pool.
The cost is paid at activation; negation or the source leaving the field does not refund it.
The effect can be used once per battle, not once per turn; separate battle IDs in the same turn remain independent.
On successful resolution, returns a temporary +3000 ATK-only modifier for that Damage Calculation; no persistent atkBoost or DEF modification is written.
Requires LP strictly greater than 2000, matching the engine's existing optional LP-cost eligibility rule.
implementation.integrationBoundary: Isolated TagDuel adapter only. It does not alter central Damage Calculation, monster registry, card catalog, certification, Discord commands, persistent player data or deployment.

focusedScenarios: defending team activation during opponent turn
shared team LP cost versus physical owner
once-per-battle receipt and second battle in same turn
LP <= 2000 rejection and no partial payment
cost retained if source leaves field before resolution
ATK-only temporary modifier; DEF and persistent atkBoost unchanged
hand above six remains untouched until End Phase
3+3 zones, Main Deck 20/30 and Extra Deck 5/overflow

limitations: The central Damage Calculation resolver must call plan/activate/resolve; this PR does not wire the card into monsterEffects or certify it.
The host must provide a unique battleId per battle and the current battle participants/teams.
A successful adapter result exposes a temporary ATK-only modifier; no persistent card stat is changed.
